scope: Keep the readable answer and valid rich components when the normal Workspace generation path encounters a malformed layout.

keep: Existing DeepSeek dispatch, native renderer, Markdown, private Share, and accounting.
extend: Repair supported list objects and retain validated sibling components in the existing OpenUI program.
Recover text and calculation defaults from validated parts, with a partial notice if any component is discarded.

schemaImpact.rollout: Existing answer and share formats continue to decode.
schemaImpact.rollback: Restore the prior compatible API and frontend pair. Keep decoding already-saved native answers.

auth.description: Use the existing authenticated Workspace and Share flows.

tenant.description: Existing account boundaries and evidence ownership remain enforced. Recovery cannot grant new evidence.

approval.description: No action or rollout approval bypass.

egress.description: The existing DeepSeek call receives revised instructions. No new transport or destination.

tests.scope: Verify repair of the observed list shape, bounded nested recovery, readable fallback, verified evidence, chart accuracy, and canonical settlement.
Verify partial native recovery, accessible rich tables, Copy and Reopen through the normal authenticated Workspace.

architecture.reason: Extend the existing Workspace assembly and pinned parser using the same persisted program and text contract.

rollout: Wait for exact-source CI and fresh private DeepSeek acceptance before requesting a canary.
rollback: Restore the last decoder-compatible release and its generation settings.
knownGaps: Malformed syntax, unsupported authority, unsafe evidence and a response with no recoverable content still use the existing fallback.
Fresh hosted acceptance and decoder recovery remain pending.

blockers: Fresh ordinary-user hosted DeepSeek acceptance and decoder recovery remain required.
